messages:
Priya Patel: Quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem — I pulled the action bullets into this thread so we can assign owners and tickets. Please claim items or @someone if you need a hand. Goal: owners + tickets by EOD Thu.

Priya Patel: Actions: 1) Add prefix KV eviction metrics + dashboards. 2) Update runbook with failover steps and TTL guidance. 3) Add automated canary job for new eviction thresholds. 4) Schedule 2-week owner rotation for cache incidents. 5) Backfill missing logs for March incidents and link to PMs.

Mike Chen: I'll take #1 (metrics + dashboards). Will create ticket and attach a rough dashboard spec. ETA: next Tue.

Mike Chen: Ticket created: OPS-4821 — "KV eviction metrics + Grafana panels". PRD link: https://redwood.app/pm/cache-pm (internal).

Sasha Ivanov: I can own #2 (runbook). Need examples of failure traces to add. @Daniel Park can you drop the event links?

Daniel Park: Sasha Ivanov: dropping links now, see below. Also noted a recurring pattern for node OOMs when queue depth spikes — should be in the runbook section.

Elaine Robinson: I'll pick #3 (canary job). Prefer a weekly slow-canary at first. Will create a job spec and ticket.

Elaine Robinson: Ticket created: SRE-2976 — "canary: eviction threshold test job". Assigned to Elaine.

Priya Patel: For #4 (rotation) — suggestion: rotate between infra-sre and runtime on a 2-week cadence. Owner takes lead for postmortem triage during rotation. Any objections?

Daniel Park: fine by me. Recommend adding a RACI row in Confluence: Responsible = oncall owner, Accountable = infra-sre lead, Consulted = runtime, Informed = eng-ops.

Sasha Ivanov: Agree with RACI. Also will add owner contact details in runbook.

Mike Chen: For #5 (log backfill) — I can help with storage queries, but need someone from product to validate event relevance. @Priya Patel can you loop PM?

Priya Patel: looping @Priya Patel (self) 😅 — I'll coordinate with PM, will ask them to confirm which March windows to prioritize.

IncidentBot: Reminder set: follow-up owners check-in in 3 days (2287657480).

Daniel Park: One more: add an automatic label on incidents that match the eviction pattern so we can query recurring hits. I'll make a small ticket.

Daniel Park: Ticket created: TOOLS-1109 — "incident label: eviction-pattern". ETA Fri.

Elaine Robinson: Quick note — for the canary job, we should avoid true production blasts. I'll add a dry-run flag and make it opt-in.

Sasha Ivanov: Runbook snippet to include: diagnostic command, how to pull KV cache stats, safe restart sequence. I'll paste template in the doc.

Mike Chen: Confirmed — OPS-4821 has a dashboard draft in attachments. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/kv-evict

Priya Patel: Thanks team. Summary: owners assigned (see tickets OPS-4821, SRE-2976, TOOLS-1109), RACI row to be added, rotation agreed. I'll publish an owners matrix after PM confirms with product. If no objections, I'll move these into the remediation tracker by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:

Elaine Robinson: No objections. :+1:

Sasha Ivanov: ACK.

Mike Chen: ACK.

Daniel Park: ACK.

Priya Patel: Closing the loop here — ping me if anything slips.
